_docs: This is the ONLY data file a company needs to edit. Swap text, tours, destinations, reviews, links and images here, then deploy — no rebuild required (images live in public/img/ and are referenced by filename only). `{year}` in copyright is replaced automatically. Set footer.newsletter.action to a form endpoint (Formspree / Mailchimp / your API) to receive real subscriptions.

site.name: Natorous
site.description: Small-group expeditions to the planet's last wild places.

hero.eyebrow: Small groups · Wild places · Expert guides
hero.text: Eight-day, expert-guided expeditions to the corners the crowds never reach. Twelve travellers max, one unforgettable planet.
hero.imageAlt: A hiker on a mountain ridge above misty valleys at sunrise

tours.heading: Trips people can't stop talking about
tours.text: Every route is scouted by our own guides and capped at twelve travellers.

items.title: Annapurna High Route
items.description: Wake to prayer flags and pink-lit peaks on a tea-house trek across the Annapurna range, past 5,000 m passes and valley monasteries.

items.title: Cliffs & Coastal Trails
items.description: Hike between sea cliffs, turf-roofed villages and waterfalls that drop straight into the North Atlantic.

items.title: Rainforest & Volcano Trail
items.description: Glide through cloud forest canopies, rappel waterfalls and watch Arenal smoke at dusk from a jungle lodge.

items.title: Dunes & Skeleton Coast
items.description: Climb the world's tallest dunes at sunrise, then track desert rhino along Africa's most haunting shoreline.

destinations.heading: Destinations off the beaten path
destinations.text: Six regions, dozens of routes — and new ones scouted every season.

reviews.heading: Don't take our word for it

items.name: Lena Hoffmann
items.text: Twelve strangers left the trailhead and came back a family. Our guide read the mountain like a book — weather, pace, teahouses — and never once made us feel rushed. The hardest and best thing I've done.

items.name: Marcus Adeyemi
items.text: I've booked tours on three continents. Nobody scouts routes like this. Sunrise on a 300 m dune with exactly zero other footprints around is something I'll be chasing for years.

items.name: Sofia Reyes
items.text: Tiny details done right: the local bakeries, the timing to dodge the cruise crowds, the absurdly good packed lunches. It felt less like a tour and more like travelling with friends who plan perfectly.

cta.heading: Ready to go where the roads end?
cta.text: Tell us your dates and fitness level — a route designer replies within one working day with two trip ideas and honest prices.

footer.about: Natorous designs small-group expeditions to the world's remaining wild places — with local guides, honest logistics and zero crowds.

newsletter.heading: Field notes, monthly
newsletter.text: One email a month — new routes, open departures, zero spam.
newsletter.successMessage: You're in! Watch your inbox for the next field note.
